name: DIY Home Assistant home security system

mentions.name: DIY Home Assistant home security system
mentions.description: A self-hosted home security system built on Home Assistant, created as an alternative to turnkey cloud security solutions the author distrusts. Claude is used to assist with the Home Assistant configuration, making the setup process enjoyable instead of the tedious slog it was previously.
mentions.problem: Turnkey cloud security solutions raise privacy concerns, and Home Assistant's configuration was previously a slog.
mentions.audience: Personal/home use for the author and his wife
mentions.source_excerpt: My wife has wanted a security system for a while. The turnkey cloud solutions freak me out. I've done some home automation with home aisstant before, and omg that was configuration slog. But with Claude..... It becomes fun.
